faq.q: What is the origin of Tahir?
faq.a: Tahir is associated with Arabic. Tahir is Arabic طَاهِر (Ṭāhir), meaning 'pure, chaste'.
Yes — the underlying form طَاهِر is Arabic.
Tahir can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Tahir should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Ṭāhir is not a Quranic personal name.
